notes.title: Dare to be the HERO! v1.5.2f2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31794976/8233661301f9cf474ec356df32ff8f4d112b230c.jpg[/img]

Now the hero is complete! You are the SteamHammer fired up in all your steampunk glory with a fully functioning exo-suit armour.

[h1]What's New in v1.5.2f2[/h1]

[list]
    [*] NEW Full Body Hero Avatar.
    [*] Default 3rd Person Auto Camera.
    [*] NEW 'Michael Bay' Camera Angle.
    [*] Movement on one controller only.
    [*] Improved frame rate performance in Massive Explosion Scenarios.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31794976/a76e0ec8e996b0aa5256c406bd0a0921d917dd54.jpg[/img]

Choose your favourite camera angle to watch all the action by pressing buttons 1-6 on your keyboard or simply leave it in the default automated 'Director Mode' which cycles all the camera views.
